stopped: Digest run stopped before it reported
lost: Digest run lost: no stop report, queued again
lost_failed: Digest run lost on its last start
backup_list_failed: Daily backup could not list the tenants: no tenant was exported
backup_export_failed: Daily backup export failed: no copy written
backup_r2_failed: Daily backup not written to R2
backup_r2_unbound: Daily backup has no R2 bucket bound: no R2 copy written
backup_missing: Daily backup not confirmed: the registry's export, written last, is not in R2, so the backup did not run, did not finish, or that export failed
backup_check_failed: Daily backup could not be checked: R2 did not answer its lookup
